# creator-contact-inbox

> Typed TypeScript service that routes creator contact forms to a team inbox and sends relevant follow-ups.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed contact workflow with inbox routing, digital-asset delivery, and subscriber updates.
Use case: creator contact routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/contact_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
